candidate.definition_en: To hit forcibly and deliberately; to stop work as a protest.
candidate.explanation_ar: إنك تضرب حاجة بقوة، أو العمال يوقفوا شغلهم كنوع من الاحتجاج.

senses.definition_en: To stop work as a protest.

examples: Workers voted to strike for better pay.
They hope to strike a balance between cost and quality.
candidate.mnemonic: هو قرر 'Strike' الكورة بقوة عشان يجيب جول.
